topic_text: दांडी मार्च में नमक क्यों चुना गया?
subject: इतिहास
reference_text: Verified reference (paraphrase), Publications Division, Government of India: https://www.publicationsdivision.nic.in/catalog/view/theme/default/images/new_ngm_final/timeline/pages/page14.html . In 1930 Gandhi proposed breaking the Salt Laws to begin a mass civil disobedience movement. Although the incidence of salt tax was relatively light, it affected the poorest people. He announced a march from his ashram in Ahmedabad to Dandi on the Arabian Sea. The salt campaign connected an everyday material with the struggle for self-rule and helped organize ordinary Indians for action. This was non-violent resistance, not an armed battle or instant independence. Do not invent medical consequences, chemistry demonstrations, exact taxes or claim immediate independence.
